    (function () {
      var AMP_ID_TTL_MS = 60 * 1000;

      function decorateConsoleLink(e) {
        var link = e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest('a[href]');
        if (!link) {
          return;

        var url;

        if (sessionId) {

        }
        url.searchParams.set('ampTimestamp', String(Date.now() + AMP_ID_TTL_MS));
        link.href = url.toString();

      function decorateConsoleLink(e) {
        var link = e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest('a[href]');

        link.href = url.toString();

    // Cross-project tracking: decorate links to the console with the visitor's
    // Amplitude device/session IDs so the console project (separate API key,
    // separate cookie) can stitch the anonymous marketing visit to the
    // signed-up console user via a portfolio view. Decorating at click time
    // keeps the IDs fresh; ampTimestamp bounds how long a copied URL is valid.
    (function () {
      var AMP_ID_TTL_MS = 60 * 1000;

      function decorateConsoleLink(e) {
        var link = e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest('a[href]');
        if (!link) {
          return;
        }
        var url;
        try {
          url = new URL(link.href);
        } catch (err) {
          return;
        }
        if (url.hostname !== 'console.statsig.com') {
          return;
        }
        if (!window.amplitude || typeof window.amplitude.getDeviceId !== 'function') {
          return;
        }
        var deviceId = window.amplitude.getDeviceId();
        if (!deviceId) {
          return;
        }
        url.searchParams.set('ampDeviceId', deviceId);
        var sessionId = window.amplitude.getSessionId();
        if (sessionId) {
          url.searchParams.set('ampSessionId', String(sessionId));
        }
        url.searchParams.set('ampTimestamp', String(Date.now() + AMP_ID_TTL_MS));
        link.href = url.toString();
      }

      // Capture phase so the href is rewritten before navigation starts;
      // auxclick covers middle-click open-in-new-tab.
      document.addEventListener('click', decorateConsoleLink, true);

    // Cross-project tracking: decorate links to the console with the visitor's
    // Amplitude device/session IDs so the console project (separate API key,
    // separate cookie) can stitch the anonymous marketing visit to the
    // signed-up console user via a portfolio view. Decorating at click time
    // keeps the IDs fresh; ampTimestamp bounds how long a copied URL is valid.
    (function () {
      var AMP_ID_TTL_MS = 60 * 1000;

      function decorateConsoleLink(e) {
        var link = e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest('a[href]');
        if (!link) {
          return;
        }
        var url;
        try {
          url = new URL(link.href);
        } catch (err) {
          return;
        }
        if (url.hostname !== 'console.statsig.com') {
          return;
        }
        if (!window.amplitude || typeof window.amplitude.getDeviceId !== 'function') {
          return;
        }
        var deviceId = window.amplitude.getDeviceId();
        if (!deviceId) {
          return;
        }
        url.searchParams.set('ampDeviceId', deviceId);
        var sessionId = window.amplitude.getSessionId();
        if (sessionId) {
          url.searchParams.set('ampSessionId', String(sessionId));
        }
        url.searchParams.set('ampTimestamp', String(Date.now() + AMP_ID_TTL_MS));
        link.href = url.toString();
      }

      // Capture phase so the href is rewritten before navigation starts;
      // auxclick covers middle-click open-in-new-tab.
      document.addEventListener('click', decorateConsoleLink, true);
      document.addEventListener('auxclick', decorateConsoleLink, true);
    })();

        var link = e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest('a[href]');
